articles.abstract_en: We examine the behavioral foundation of rational inattention within a menu-choice framework. Unlike previous studies, our approach enables the unique identification of nonadditive information costs. The nonadditivity of information costs makes the effective cost inherently dependent on benefits of information. In contrast to additive cost models, this feature may lead to a violation of the preference for early resolution of menu uncertainty. Early resolution is typically preferable as it allows the agent to fine-tune information for relevant menus. However, if the effective cost function is convex in benefits of information, late resolution may reduce the effective information costs. The violation occurs when this cost-reduction effect outweighs the benefits of early resolution.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们在菜单选择框架内考察理性疏忽的行为基础。与以往研究不同，我们的方法能够唯一识别非加性信息成本。信息成本的非加性使得有效成本本质上依赖于信息的收益。与加性成本模型相比，这一特征可能导致对菜单不确定性早期解决偏好的违反。早期解决通常更受青睐，因为它允许代理人针对相关菜单微调信息。然而，如果有效成本函数在信息收益上是凸的，晚期解决可能降低有效信息成本。当这种成本降低效应超过早期解决的收益时，就会发生违反。

articles.title_en: An alternative approach for nonparametric analysis of random utility models
articles.title_cn: 随机效用模型非参数分析的另一种方法
articles.abstract_en: We readdress the problem of nonparametric statistical testing of random utility models proposed in Kitamura and Stoye (2018). Although their test is elegant, it is subject to computational constraints which leaves execution of the test infeasible in many applications. We note that much of the computational burden in Kitamura and Stoye's test is due to their test defining a polyhedral cone through its vertices rather than its faces. We propose an alternative but equivalent hypothesis test for random utility models. This test relies on a series of equality and inequality constraints which defines the faces of the corresponding polyhedral cone. Building on our testing procedure, we develop a novel axiomatization of the random utility model.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们重新探讨了Kitamura和Stoye（2018）提出的随机效用模型非参数统计检验问题。尽管他们的检验方法优雅，但受计算限制，在许多应用中无法执行。我们注意到，Kitamura和Stoye检验中的大部分计算负担源于其检验通过顶点而非面来定义多面体锥。我们提出了一种替代但等价的随机效用模型假设检验。该检验依赖于一系列等式和不等式约束，这些约束定义了相应多面体锥的面。基于我们的检验程序，我们发展了一种新的随机效用模型公理化体系。

articles.title_en: Bidding in multi-unit auctions under limited information
articles.title_cn: 有限信息下的多单位拍卖投标
articles.abstract_en: Multi-unit auctions frequently take place in environments with limited information, such as in new markets and under volatile macroeconomic conditions. We characterize optimal prior-free bids in such auctions; these bids minimize the maximal loss in expected utility resulting from uncertainty surrounding opponent behavior. We show that optimal bids are readily computable in this environment despite bidders having multi-dimensional private information. In the pay-as-bid auction the prior-free bid is unique; in the uniform-price auction the prior-free bid is unique if the bidder is allowed to determine the quantities for which they bid, as in many practical applications. We compare prior-free bids and auction outcomes across auction formats; while outcome comparisons are ambiguous, pay-as-bid auctions tend to generate greater revenue and welfare than uniform-price auctions when bidders' values are dispersed. We also compare outcomes in limited-information environments to outcomes in high-information environments, modeled as bidders playing Bayes-Nash equilibrium, and show that Bayes-Nash outcomes dominate prior-free outcomes when the auction is competitive.
articles.abstract_cn: 多单位拍卖经常在信息有限的环境中进行，例如在新市场和宏观经济条件波动的情况下。我们刻画了此类拍卖中的最优无先验投标；这些投标最小化了因对手行为不确定性导致的预期效用的最大损失。我们表明，尽管投标人拥有多维私人信息，最优投标在此环境中易于计算。在按报价支付拍卖中，无先验投标是唯一的；在统一价格拍卖中，如果投标人如许多实际应用中被允许确定其投标数量，则无先验投标是唯一的。我们比较了不同拍卖形式下的无先验投标和拍卖结果；虽然结果比较不明确，但当投标人的价值分散时，按报价支付拍卖往往比统一价格拍卖产生更高的收入和福利。我们还将有限信息环境中的结果与高信息环境中的结果进行比较，后者建模为投标人参与贝叶斯-纳什均衡，并表明当拍卖具有竞争性时，贝叶斯-纳什结果优于无先验结果。

articles.title_en: Minimal contagious sets: Degree distributional bounds
articles.title_cn: 最小传染集：度分布界限
articles.abstract_en: Agents in a network adopt an innovation if a certain fraction of their neighbors has already done so. We study the minimal contagious set size required for a successful innovation adoption by the entire population, and provide upper and lower bounds on it. Since detailed information about the network structure is often unavailable, we study bounds that depend only on the degree distribution of the network – a simple statistic of the network topology. Moreover, as our bounds are robust to small changes in the degree distribution, they also apply to large networks for which the degree distribution can only be approximated. Applying our bounds to growing networks shows that the minimal contagious set size is linear in the number of nodes. Consequently, for outside of knife-edge cases (such as the star-shaped network), contagion cannot be achieved without seeding a significant fraction of the population. This finding highlights the resilience of networks and demonstrates a high penetration cost in the corresponding markets.
articles.abstract_cn: 网络中的代理人如果其一定比例的邻居已经采纳了一项创新，则他们也会采纳。我们研究了成功实现整个群体采纳创新所需的最小传染集规模，并提供了其上下界。由于关于网络结构的详细信息往往不可得，我们研究了仅依赖于网络度分布（网络拓扑的一个简单统计量）的界限。此外，由于我们的界限对度分布的微小变化具有稳健性，它们也适用于度分布只能近似估计的大型网络。将我们的界限应用于增长网络表明，最小传染集规模与节点数量呈线性关系。因此，在非刀锋边缘情况（如星形网络）之外，如果不向显著比例的人口进行初始推广，传染就无法实现。这一发现凸显了网络的韧性，并展示了相应市场中高昂的渗透成本。

articles.title_en: Business cycles fluctuations in three-sector intertemporal equilibrium models
articles.title_cn: 三部门跨期均衡模型中的商业周期波动
articles.abstract_en: This paper introduces a novel mechanism driving endogenous business cycle fluctuations within a frictionless three-sector intertemporal equilibrium model. We emphasize the critical role of consumer preferences as a primary driver of cyclical dynamics by considering a consumption bundle composed of a pure consumption good and a mixed consumption-investment good that simultaneously serves as both a final consumption good and a capital-accumulating investment good. Endogenous fluctuations naturally arise from sectoral capital intensity differences, an intertemporal consumption trade-off between the two goods, or the interaction of both mechanisms. We offer a detailed characterization of the economy's dynamics, identifying the Hopf bifurcation conditions that trigger persistent cyclical behavior. Additionally, we explore the periodicity of the resulting limit cycles, providing insights into how shifts in preferences and sectoral complementarities can generate self-sustained macroeconomic fluctuations.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文在一个无摩擦的三部门跨期均衡模型中引入了一种驱动内生商业周期波动的新机制。我们通过考虑由纯消费品和混合消费-投资品组成的消费束，强调了消费者偏好作为周期动态主要驱动因素的关键作用，其中混合品同时作为最终消费品和资本积累投资品。内生波动自然源于部门资本密集度差异、两种商品之间的跨期消费权衡，或这两种机制的相互作用。我们详细刻画了经济的动态特征，识别出触发持续周期行为的Hopf分岔条件。此外，我们探讨了由此产生的极限环的周期性，揭示了偏好变化和部门互补性如何能够产生自我维持的宏观经济波动。

articles.title_en: Perverse ethical concerns: Misinformation and coordination
articles.title_cn: 反常的道德关切：错误信息与协调
articles.abstract_en: We study a coordination game played by a large number of agents, who acquire private signals about a hidden state on a platform before choosing individual actions. The platform privately and imperfectly filters misinformation, improving the precision of these signals. We show that a platform with an ethical concern to proactively improve agents' welfare could perversely reduce their welfare by aggravating their disagreements about the state and in turn undermining coordination. We also show that misinformation regulations aimed at improving agents' welfare are effective if and only if their implementation is sufficiently aggressive.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个由大量代理人参与的协调博弈，这些代理人在选择个人行动之前，在平台上获取关于隐藏状态的私人信号。平台私下且不完美地过滤错误信息，提高这些信号的精确度。我们表明，一个具有主动改善代理人福利的道德关切的平台，可能会反常地通过加剧他们对状态的分歧，进而破坏协调，从而降低他们的福利。我们还表明，旨在改善代理人福利的错误信息监管，当且仅当其执行足够激进时才有效。

articles.title_en: Discrete/continuous choice models and representative consumer theory
articles.title_cn: 离散/连续选择模型与代表性消费者理论
articles.abstract_en: We establish the integrability of demand for a broad class of discrete/continuous choice, additive, homothetic random-utility models of individual consumer behavior with perfect substitutes preferences (linear indifference curves) and divisible goods. We derive the corresponding indirect utility function and then establish a representative consumer formulation for this entire class of models. The representative consumer is always normative, facilitating aggregate welfare analysis. These findings should be of interest to the literature in macro, trade, industrial organization, labor, and ideal price index measurement that use representative consumer models, such as CES and its variants. Our results generalize such representative consumer formulations to the broad, empirically-relevant class of models of behavior that are routinely used in the discrete/continuous choice analysis of micro data, including specifications that do not suffer from the IIA property and that allow for heterogeneous consumer preferences and incomes. These flexible discrete/continuous choice formulations also overcome many of the known limitations of CES and its variants for equilibrium prices and markups, trade liberalization effects and welfare analysis. We also discuss quasi-linear integrability in the case where products are indivisible and integrability no longer holds. If we relax homotheticity, we find that integrability generically fails to hold except in the special case of IIA preferences.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们建立了一类广泛的离散/连续选择、可加、同质随机效用模型下消费者行为的可积性，该模型具有完全替代偏好（线性无差异曲线）和可分割商品。我们推导了相应的间接效用函数，然后为这一整类模型建立了代表性消费者表述。代表性消费者始终是规范性的，便于进行总体福利分析。这些发现应引起宏观、贸易、产业组织、劳动以及理想价格指数测量等领域中使用代表性消费者模型（如CES及其变体）的文献关注。我们的结果将此类代表性消费者表述推广到广泛且经验相关的行为模型类别，这些模型常用于微观数据的离散/连续选择分析，包括不具有IIA性质且允许消费者偏好和收入异质性的规格。这些灵活的离散/连续选择表述也克服了CES及其变体在均衡价格和加成、贸易自由化效应以及福利分析方面的许多已知局限性。我们还讨论了在商品不可分割且可积性不再成立的情况下的拟线性可积性。如果我们放宽同质性，我们发现可积性通常不成立，除非在IIA偏好的特殊情况下。

articles.title_en: Universal social welfare orderings and risk
articles.title_cn: 普遍社会福利排序与风险
articles.abstract_en: How can social prospects be evaluated and compared when there may be a risk on i) the actual allocations that people will receive, ii) the existence of these future people, and iii) their preferences? This paper investigates this question, which can arise when considering policies, such as climate policy, that affect people who do not yet exist. We start from the observation that there is no social ordering that meets minimal requirements of fairness, social rationality, and respect for people's ex ante preferences. We explore three ways around this impossibility. First, if we drop the ex ante Pareto requirement, we can obtain fair ex post criteria that take an (arbitrary) expected utility of an equally-distributed equivalent level of well-being. Second, if the social ordering is not an expected utility, we can obtain fair ex ante criteria that evaluate uncertain individual prospects with a certainty-equivalent measure of well-being. Third, if we accept that interpersonal comparisons rely on VNM utility functions even in absence of risk, we can construct expected utility social orderings that satisfy a version of Pareto ex ante.
articles.abstract_cn: 当可能存在以下风险时，如何评估和比较社会前景：i) 人们实际获得的分配，ii) 这些未来人的存在，以及 iii) 他们的偏好？本文探讨了这一问题，这一问题在考虑影响尚未存在的人的政策（如气候政策）时可能出现。我们从观察出发，即不存在满足公平、社会理性和尊重人们事前偏好的最低要求的社会排序。我们探索了绕过这一不可能性的三种途径。首先，如果我们放弃事前帕累托要求，我们可以获得公平的事后标准，该标准采用（任意的）等分布等效福利水平的期望效用。其次，如果社会排序不是期望效用，我们可以获得公平的事前标准，该标准用确定性等效福利度量来评估不确定的个人前景。第三，如果我们接受即使在无风险情况下人际比较也依赖于VNM效用函数，我们可以构建满足帕累托事前版本一部分的期望效用社会排序。

articles.title_cn: 学习未完全指定的模型
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines learning dynamics under non-parametric model uncertainty. We choose the monopolistic profit maximization problem (Myerson (1981)) as our laboratory. We consider a monopolist who chooses a learning algorithm to select a price following a history, facing non-parametric model uncertainty about the probability distribution of the buyer's valuation and bearing the computational cost. We posit that the monopolist has a lexicographic preference over profit and computational complexity while seeking an ϵ dominant algorithm that prescribes an ϵ best response against any cumulative distribution function of the buyer's valuation for any small ϵ>0. We construct a simplest ϵ dominant algorithm among all dominant algorithms when the distribution of the buyer's valuation satisfies the increasing hazard rate property. Our algorithm recursively estimates two parameters of the distribution, even if the actual distribution is parameterized by many more variables. The monopolist chooses a misspecified model to save computational cost while learning the true optimal decision uniformly over the set of feasible distributions.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了非参数模型不确定性下的学习动态。我们选择垄断利润最大化问题（Myerson (1981)）作为实验环境。我们考虑一个垄断者，他选择一种学习算法，根据历史记录来选定价格，面临关于买方估值概率分布的非参数模型不确定性，并承担计算成本。我们假设垄断者对利润和计算复杂度具有字典序偏好，同时寻求一个ϵ占优算法，该算法针对买方估值的任何累积分布函数，对于任何小的ϵ>0，都规定一个ϵ最佳反应。当买方估值的分布满足递增风险率性质时，我们在所有占优算法中构造了一个最简单的ϵ占优算法。我们的算法递归地估计分布的两个参数，即使实际分布由更多变量参数化。垄断者选择一个错误指定的模型以节省计算成本，同时在可行分布集合上一致地学习真实的最优决策。

articles.title_cn: 一个易处理的团体全支付拍卖
articles.abstract_en: We consider group all-pay auctions with a wide range of effort complementarity in which teammates coordinate efforts via a group-specific correlation device. Under mild regularity conditions, there is a unique equilibrium effort distribution, independent of the distribution of the correlation device. We characterize this unique distribution of efforts and analyze the effects of value dispersion, degree of complementarity, and group size. We show that this effort distribution can be achieved without correlation devices as the equilibrium outcome of a cheap talk game in which players engage in costless unmediated preplay communication.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑具有广泛努力互补性的团体全支付拍卖，其中队友通过团体特定的关联设备协调努力。在温和的正则条件下，存在唯一的均衡努力分布，该分布独立于关联设备的分布。我们刻画了这一独特的努力分布，并分析了价值分散、互补程度和团体规模的影响。我们表明，这种努力分布可以通过廉价交谈博弈的均衡结果实现，无需关联设备，在该博弈中，玩家进行无成本的、无中介的事前沟通。

articles.title_en: The economics of career concerns in teamwork
articles.title_cn: 团队合作中职业关注的经济学
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines incentives in teams of career-concerned members, where effort and talent can be substitutes (Holmström, 1999) or complements (Dewatripont et al., 1999). It is shown that the degree of effort-talent complementarity determines which team member exerts more effort and thus gains or loses more reputation following team performance. The paper argues that organizations can boost incentives by promoting concern for collective reputation. Strategies to achieve this include facilitating team cooperation, limiting external competition for individual talent, and positively sorting talent into teams. The paper further explores optimal performance ratings to motivate teams when the organization has easy access to individual outputs. These ratings generally deviate from team output and may even induce competition, depending on the signal-to-noise ratio and talent correlations.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了由具有职业关注成员组成的团队中的激励问题，其中努力与才能可以是替代品（Holmström, 1999）或互补品（Dewatripont et al., 1999）。研究表明，努力与才能的互补程度决定了哪位团队成员付出更多努力，从而在团队绩效之后获得或失去更多声誉。本文认为，组织可以通过促进对集体声誉的关注来增强激励。实现这一目标的策略包括促进团队合作、限制对个人才能的外部竞争，以及将人才正向分类到团队中。本文进一步探讨了当组织容易获取个人产出时，如何设定最优绩效评级以激励团队。这些评级通常偏离团队产出，甚至可能引发竞争，这取决于信噪比和才能相关性。

articles.title_en: Dynamic information design in an entry game
articles.title_cn: 进入博弈中的动态信息设计
articles.abstract_en: We study dynamic Bayesian persuasion in an entry game. A sender publicly reveals information to an adopter and a competitor who decide when to irreversibly enter or exit a market. When the sender's loss from competition is small, the sender first provides information to attract the adopter, and then aims to reveal sufficiently negative information to deter the competitor. Otherwise, the optimal policy is reversed. The sender first aims to provide negative information to deter the competitor and then to reveal positive information to attract the adopter. We interpret the optimal policy as inducing hype cycles, and show that hype cycles are more severe in stagnant industries or with higher threat of competition.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究进入博弈中的动态贝叶斯说服。一个发送者公开地向一个采纳者和一个竞争者揭示信息，他们决定何时不可逆地进入或退出市场。当发送者因竞争而遭受的损失较小时，发送者首先提供信息以吸引采纳者，然后旨在揭示足够负面的信息以阻止竞争者。否则，最优策略则相反。发送者首先旨在提供负面信息以阻止竞争者，然后揭示正面信息以吸引采纳者。我们将最优策略解释为引发炒作周期，并表明在停滞行业或竞争威胁更高的情况下，炒作周期更为严重。
